subject: Add setting for opening multiple connections with Enter
body:
Add setting for opening multiple connections with Enter

Added ApplyOpenMultipleConnectionsWithEnter to OptRegistryConnectionsPage to support the new OpenMultipleConnectionsWithEnter setting. Updated project file to include UI\Helpers\ folder. Replaced window.Close() with window.Dispose() in ConnectionTreeWindowGetDirectChildConnectionsTests for better resource management.

security_flags.reason: a new or repointed package can pull arbitrary code at restore time

triage.rationale: Incomplete commit. It is part of a multi-commit feature (not mapping to any open issue) and contains only settings boilerplate without the actual behavior.
